evals.prompt: We're a food company sourcing palm oil and cocoa. Should we be worried about biodiversity risks?
evals.expected_output: High-risk assessment: identifies deforestation driver, EUDR exposure, supply chain biodiversity impacts.
assertions: Flags palm oil and cocoa as EUDR-regulated commodities
Identifies land use change as primary biodiversity driver
Mentions TNFD LEAP approach for structured assessment
Recommends geolocation traceability for supply chain

evals.prompt: Abbiamo un impianto produttivo vicino a un sito Natura 2000 in Sardegna. Ci sono implicazioni per il reporting ESRS?
evals.expected_output: Identifies ESRS E4 materiality, VIncA procedure, Natura 2000 implications.
assertions: Flags ESRS E4 as likely material due to proximity to protected area
Mentions VIncA (Valutazione di Incidenza Ambientale) requirement
References specific Natura 2000 context in Italy/Sardinia
Suggests using IBAT tool for detailed assessment

evals.prompt: Abbiamo un progetto di rigenerazione della biodiversita su un terreno agricolo di 0,93 ha vicino a un'area Natura 2000 in Lombardia. Abbiamo piantato 265 alberi e arbusti autoctoni nel 2022. Il valore MSA pre-intervento era 32,1 e post-intervento 67,8. Abbiamo calcolato 3,32 crediti di biodiversita per il 2024. Puoi verificare la conformita alla UNI/PdR 179?
evals.expected_output: Compliance review: verifies MSA calculation, credits formula, identifies gaps vs UNI/PdR 179 audit checklist.
assertions: Recognizes UNI/PdR 179:2025 as the applicable framework
Verifies the Biodiversity Credits formula: CB = delta_MSA x ha x anni x 10
Checks the MSA delta calculation (67.8 - 32.1 = 35.7 points, 0.357 on 0-1 scale)
Verifies credit calculation: 0.357 x 0.93 x 1 x 10 = 3.32 CB
References the audit checklist from Appendice F or G for gap analysis
Checks for additionality requirement

evals.prompt: Devo redigere un Piano di Biodiversita per un sito aziendale di 5 ettari in Pianura Padana, vicino a risaie e a un'area Natura 2000. Cosa deve contenere secondo la UNI/PdR 179?
evals.expected_output: Structured guidance on Biodiversity Plan contents per UNI/PdR 179 punto 5.2.3.
assertions: References UNI/PdR 179 punto 5.2.3 for Piano di Biodiversita structure
Specifies MSA as mandatory KPI for target definition
Describes the mitigation hierarchy: in-situ actions priority, non-in-situ within 150 km as integrative
Mentions required sections: target definition, intervention plan, monitoring design, training plan, stakeholder engagement
References the 5-year cycle and reporting timeline (report iniziale, annuale, quinquennale)
Mentions proximity to Natura 2000 as requiring assessment within 5 km radius
